mappings.coverage: bounded whole numeric conversion and text-mode token reader
mappings.qualification: Terminated byte strings, numeric reader tokens below64bytes, finite stored floating intermediates. Text-mode reader composition covered; binary token decoding remains an explicit service in portable API, not exercised here. Decimal integer wraps32bits and consumes optionalminus/digitprefix; no plus or whitespace. Hex consumeswholeinput, any invalidbyte returns0. Readers recognize$and0xprefixes. Real parser does not implement exponent syntax. It rounds after every multiply, add, divisor scale and final divide; minuszero retained. Full audio parsing through these helpers is separate; managed execution pending.
mappings.comparisonStatus: Original native/model differential passed; managed replay pending.
